0022600139.text: The Warriors (1-3, 12th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific) visit the Timberwolves (3-1, 6th in the West and 1 game back in the Northwest) in the fifth game of Golden State's season, with the Warriors 1-2 on the road and Minnesota coming off a loss. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision after averaging 21.8 points. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Anthony Edwards is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision; the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on March 13, 2026, in San Francisco, a 127-117 Warriors loss, with the Warriors losing the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
